main_text.p: rato consensu Ioannis Pontificis, rursus denuo Photium Patriarcham recreat, conuocato Concilio, Legatis Ioannis interuenientibus, & omnia vno ore comprobantibus. Concilium callide procurauerat Photius, vt sui restitutionem constabiliret, sciens, Pontificem, siue Presbyterum, siue iuste, siue iniuste condemnatum eiectumq; per Concilium in locum priftinum, vnde cecidit, restitui non posse, crimen ab Arianis obiectum Athanasio, & Ioanni Chrysostomo a Theophilo Alexandrino. Et haec etiam Synodus sic a Photio siue confecta, siue vere coacta, vel in parte vel in omnibus, sub Octauae Synodi nomine innotuit apud Graecos Schismaticos. page.notes: The first word "consensu" is printed with long s as "confenfu". The reading "confiCta" in the last sentence is printed "confiCta"; I have read it as "confecta", which is not fully certain, so it should be checked against the scan. "priftinum" is kept as printed. The line ends with the hyphenated word "nomi-", which continues on the next page.
